verdict.rationale: Jira's own Rovo AI is documented to create custom automations, break big ideas into tasks and auto-assign them, and surface trends. That is first-party AI-driven operation of the product. However, the evidence never states that users issue natural-language commands or prompts; it is only implied by the AI-assist marketing. The official MCP server belongs to a separate agent-connectivity story and is not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a natural-language command or prompt interface, breadth of operations controllable via NL (create/edit/transition/query issues), independent or hands-on corroboration.
